ACI-WORKFLOW-BINDING-V1:
Design a concrete subagent team for the next stage of the Repository Irreducible Problem Inventory research. Read AGENTS.md first and obey it. Read the complete research/repository-irreducible-problem-inventory/research-initial-definitions.md, research/repository-irreducible-problem-inventory/stages/exploration/research.md, research/repository-irreducible-problem-inventory/stages/exploration/findings.md, and sessions/2026-08-04-1730-repository-irreducible-problem-exploration.md. The owner has explicitly decided that the research may produce candidates and hypotheses; it does not need to prove irreducibility, minimality, or completeness before being useful. Do not perform the substantive research and do not launch agents. Propose the smallest effective team: each seat's role, distinct lens, exact corpus boundary, question, expected return, dependencies/topology, and a rough token budget. Identify what can be handled by the parent instead of a seat, prevent duplicated roles, and include a lean fallback. Write the complete proposal only to research/repository-irreducible-problem-inventory/team-design/findings.md using apply_patch; edit no other file. End with one recommended composition and the main trade-off.
